Go MCP server; Go 1.13–1.24; clean architecture, DI, repository, embedded JSON, MCP `go-updates`. Add `data/releases/go{version}.json`; auto-discovered; no code changes; preserve JSON structure. Commands:
`go build -o recent-go-mcp`
`go test ./...`
`go test -v -run TestMCPServer`
`go mod tidy`
`go fmt ./...`
`go vet ./...`
MCP:
`echo '{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/list"}' | ./recent-go-mcp`
